issues.issue: P5 cliplist: three raw identifiers (d591db2c-0a82-482e-a8c8-5f93768b9a24, 69e48d8e849ab9426f17022d, composer-5gohk1eo6) are printed as unlabeled body text directly under the project title, so the top of the screen reads as debug output.
P5 cliplist: five controls carry the same weight, an outlined 'Export all', 'Generate with AI' and four identical 'Download' buttons in the track rows, so no single next step wins.
P5 editor: 'Unsaved changes' and the black 'Apply changes' sit at the bottom right below the 'Download MP4 / SRT / VTT / Meta / Poster' row, so the panel offers two competing ends for the same task.

P6 cliplist: the black 'Review 6 clips' button in the top-right header and the per-row Keep/Maybe/Skip links do the same triage job at the same time, and the header button is 700px from the rows it acts on.

P6 cliplist: the decision state is carried only by weight, 'Keep' is bold on row 01 and gray on rows 02 to 06, with no checkmark or filled control, so a scan of six clips cannot tell kept from unjudged.
P6 editor: literal paragraph marks render inline in the transcript ('That's not my wheelhouse. ¶' and 'per challenge, ¶'), so the text looks like raw markup.
P2 editor: the whole editing surface is transcript and waveform with no video frame anywhere, so there is no player to look at while cutting and the page has no visual anchor.
P2 editor: the player toolbar's last control is clipped to a pill showing only 'E' at the right edge (x about 972), cut off by the AI Tools panel.
P2 editor: an upload card ('Demo Projects', 'Transcribing... 34%') is rendered inside the transcript column between paragraphs, breaking the text flow with a status widget.
P3 editor: the open item is a text issue page with a Properties sidebar and nothing to play or trim, so no video surface exists to work on.
P3 cliplist: the full-width 'Auto headline' notice with a 40-word paragraph and a 'Disable it' link sits above the clips and pushes every thumbnail down, so the notice outranks the work.
P3 cliplist: the left rail holds seven unlabeled line icons with the workspace avatar ('S', filled square) in the same 32px slot, so navigation and account are indistinguishable.
P4 cliplist: tag pills truncate mid-word at 10px ('Squa', 'Migra', 'Frontend user d...'), and six rows print a literal '---' placeholder in the status column.
P4 editor: the top row packs '9:16', 'Layout: Fill', B/i/S icons, 'Color correction: OFF' and 'Tracker: O' with no separators, and 'Tracker: O' is cut off against the right rail.
P4 editor: transcript words are underlined in green, pink and yellow with no legend, so emphasis reads as error highlighting.
P1 cliplist: the globe and kebab columns have no header while Name, Duration, Created and 'Last viewed' do, and the open row menu covers the 'Last viewed' values it sits over.
P1 cliplist: 'Last viewed' wraps to two lines in the header while the other three headers stay one line, and every secondary cell is the same 12px gray as the disabled-looking icon column.
P1 editor: the Details panel prints 'Saved: C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/CapCut Drafts/ 1025 (1)' as a wrapped raw path with the 'Modify' button detached at the panel's bottom right.

notes: Only P5 has an error screen, and it is the strongest thing in the panel: named failing step, 'whisper-cli exited with code 134 (SIGABRT)' behind Copy details, 'Retry stage' primary with 'Start over' explained, and stages 4 to 7 shown waiting. Codes do not look stable across states (P5 cliplist is a dark recordings/tracks screen while P5 editor and error are 'Clipping Factory | Local studio', and P6 cliplist is that same Clipping Factory screen while P6 editor is a different dark editor), so several codes score as a set of two products rather than one.
